result:
I've fixed all nine reports in the comment code. The type-check is clean and the existing suite passes (616 tests). I didn't write new tests, so most of the new behaviour hasn't been exercised directly.

- **Mentions** (`src/lib/mentions.ts`, `comment-service.ts`):
  - The lookup now pages through every active member instead of stopping at 100. That was the cause of the long-standing members being missed.
  - Viewers can be mentioned.
  - A handle shared by several members mentions all of them.
  - The author's own handle is ignored.
  - Only mentions parsed from the text are recorded. The client-supplied mention ids are no longer merged in.
- **Alerts** (`notification-service.ts`):
  - A comment alert goes to the issue's author, its assignee and, for a reply, the parent comment's author. The comment's author gets none.
  - Anyone the comment mentions gets the mention alert only, never both.
- **Thread** (`comment-repository.ts`): every reply under a top-level comment is listed in posting order, however deep the chain. A deleted comment stays in place with its text blanked, so its replies stay put. I didn't add a separate "deleted" marker field. A deleted comment shows as one with `archivedAt` set and an empty body. The comment count already excluded deleted comments.
- **Edits**:
  - The 15-minute limit is counted from `createdAt`, not from the last edit.
  - An edit re-reads the mentions and stores exactly what the new text mentions.
  - Only people newly mentioned are alerted.
  - Search is reindexed. This uses a new `comment.updated` event, which search and notifications both listen to.
- **Rate limit**: the posting bucket is now keyed per member, so one person's burst no longer blocks anyone else.

I used SQLite's `rowid` as the tie-breaker for comments posted at the same timestamp.
